questions.text: What is the primary purpose of an API?
options: To define the visual style of an application
To allow different software applications to communicate with each other
questions.correctAnswer: To allow different software applications to communicate with each other

questions.text: Which architectural style is commonly used for web APIs, using standard HTTP methods?
In a REST API, what HTTP method is typically used to retrieve data from a server?
What HTTP method is typically used to create a new resource on the server?

options: The client application making the request
A specific URL where an API can be accessed
The format of the data returned
questions.correctAnswer: A specific URL where an API can be accessed

questions.text: What does an HTTP Status Code like '200 OK' indicate?
options: The request failed due to a client error
The requested resource was not found

questions.text: What does an HTTP Status Code like '404 Not Found' indicate?
options: The server could not find the requested resource
The server encountered an internal error
questions.correctAnswer: The server could not find the requested resource

questions.text: Which data format is most commonly used for sending and receiving data in modern web APIs?

options: Defining the structure of API requests
Verifying the identity of the client making the API request
Limiting the number of requests a client can make
Formatting the data returned by the API
questions.correctAnswer: Verifying the identity of the client making the API request
